course_info.faculty: Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences
course_info.course: Monte Carlo Methods in Finance - IE 436

catalog_course_description: The course aims to introduce the Monte Carlo methods and techniques used in mathematical finance. In this field, many problems involve computing expectations. Pricing various derivatives, computing default/ruin probabilities, finding optimal/well-performing portfolios are some well-known examples of such problems. In the course, after discussing the basics of probability and simulation, we learn how Monte Carlo methods apply to these problems.
course_learning_outcomes: Apply algorithms for random variable generation,
Generate sample paths of certain stochastic processes,
Apply Monte Carlo methods for the computations of expectation expressions arising in mathematical finance (for pricing derivative instruments, computing ruin probabilities, etc.)
course_objective: Introduce the Monte Carlo approach and teach its applications in the problems of mathematical finance
